options.D: others 【答案】A 【详解】句意：去机场的公共汽车刚开。我们得等半个小时才能再来一辆。 考查代词词义辨析。another另一，又一（无范围）；other其他的（后接可数名词复数形式）；the other两个中的另一个；the others剩余的全部。根据“The bus to the airport has just left.”可知去机场的公共汽车刚开了，得再等另一辆，且没有范围，故用another。故选A。

questions.topicReason: 考查反身代词，句意为“不仅尊重父母，也尊重我们自己”，应用ourselves。

questions.topicReason: 考查名词性物主代词 yours，相当于 your wish。

questions.prompt: My father has got a lot of friends in Shanghai and one of ________ is a policeman.

options.D: themselves 【答案】B 【详解】句意：我父亲在上海有很多朋友，其中一个是警察。 考查代词辨析。their他们的；them他们；theirs他们的；themselves他们自己。根据“My father has got a lot of friends in Shanghai”可知，是指很多朋友中的一个是警察，位于介词of后，应用宾格them。故选B。

questions.topicReason: 考查人称代词宾格，介词 of 后用 them，one of them 表示他们中的一个。

questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词辨析，several ways 表示三者及以上，否定用 none。

questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词 little/few/many/much 的用法，know little about 表示知之甚少。

options.D: themselves 【答案】C 【详解】句意：在介绍完她最喜爱的商店之后，詹妮问学生们关于他们的商店。 考查代词。them他们，宾格；their他们的，形容词性物主代词；theirs他们的，名词性物主代词；themselves他们自己，反身代词。根据“her favourite shop”和句意可知，此处指他们的商店，用名词性物主代词。故选C。

questions.topicReason: 考查名词性物主代词theirs，指代“their favourite shops”，相当于their shops。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市闵行区2023-2024学年九年级上学期（一模）期末英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: It’s not safe for the little boy to walk to _________ side of the road all by himself.

options.D: the others 【答案】B 【详解】句意：对于这个小男孩来说，独自走到马路的另一边是不安全的。 考查代词辨析。other其他的，后加复数名词；the other另一个，指两者当中的另一个；others其他的人或物，表示泛指；the others其他的人或物，表示特指。根据“walk to … side of the road”可知，这里指的是走到道路的另一边，道路是两边，表示两者当中另一个，应该是the other。故选B。

questions.topicReason: 考查other系列用法，道路有两边，表示两者中的另一边用the other。

questions.topicReason: 考查复合不定代词，否定句中表示“任何事”用anything。

questions.prompt: After running for an hour, I hardly had ________ energy left to climb the stairs.
questions.topicReason: hardly 表示否定意义，energy 为不可数名词，考查 any 的用法。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市宝山区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: The program aims to teach children how to protect ________ in emergencies.
questions.topicReason: 考查反身代词用法，children 保护的是“他们自己”，应用 themselves。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市宝山区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: After finishing a short video about traditional Chinese customs, Jack planned to make ________ one this term.
questions.topicReason: 考查 another/other/the other 等不定代词辨析，表示“再做一个/另一个”用 another。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市宝山区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: There is ________ milk left in the fridge. Could you buy some on your way home?
questions.topicReason: 考查 few/a few/little/a little 的数量代词或限定词辨析；milk 为不可数名词，且语境表示“几乎没有”，应用 little。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市崇明区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Tracy asked Mr. Black to teach ________ how to make impressive videos.
questions.topicReason: 考查人称代词宾格；teach 后接宾语，应用 her。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市崇明区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Mr. Green has just come to live in this village, so ________ is known about his life.
questions.topicReason: 考查 few/a few/little/a little 的辨析；life 为不可数概念，且语境表示“几乎不了解”，用 little。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市崇明区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Teresa searched for the missing gold ring in the house; unfortunately, ________ was found.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词辨析；根据 unfortunately 和 was found 可知“什么也没找到”，用 nothing。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市徐汇区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: The food in Shanghai is not as hot as ________ in Sichuan.
questions.topicReason: 用 that 指代前文同类不可数名词 the food，避免重复，考查代词替代。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市徐汇区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Although Mike and Joe’s plan sounds attractive, ________ can solve the problem better.
questions.topicReason: 空格作主语，指“我们的计划”，需用名词性物主代词 ours，考查代词用法。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市徐汇区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: We’re always told that ________ can stop a man with a strong will from achieving success.
questions.topicReason: 句意为“没有什么能阻止意志坚强的人成功”，考查不定代词 nothing。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市普陀区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: I’ve already had two cups of coffee, but I can still have ________.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词another，表示“再一个，另一个”。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市虹口区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: The five-week course is designed to help you express ________ in a natural way.
questions.topicReason: 考查反身代词作宾语，express oneself 表示“表达自己”。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市虹口区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: An excuse is a reason you give in order to explain why ________ has been done wrong.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词，something 表示“某事”，符合句意。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海嘉定初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: My brother and I like playing Ping-Pong. ________ play together on Saturdays.
questions.topicReason: 前文是My brother and I，后文作主语指“我们”，考查人称代词We。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海嘉定初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Lin Dong has three cousins in Beijing, and he also has ________ one in Guangzhou.
questions.topicReason: 表示“另一个”未限定范围中的单数人或物，用another，考查不定代词辨析。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海奉贤初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: —Excuse me, is this your English-Chinese dictionary? —No, it isn’t. ________ is here in my schoolbag.
questions.topicReason: 考查名词性物主代词，Mine相当于my dictionary。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海奉贤初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: —Which sweater do you prefer, the red one or the blue one? —______ is OK. I don’t mind the colour as long as it feels comfortable.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词either，表示两者中任意一个都可以。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海崇明初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Listen to other groups’ presentations and make comments on ________ travel plans.
questions.topicReason: 考查形容词性物主代词their，修饰名词travel plans。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海崇明初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Living conditions were bad there. ________ homes had a bathroom with a toilet or bath.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词few/a few/little/a little的辨析；homes为可数名词复数，且语境表示否定含义，用Few。

questions.sourceFile: 2026年上海市杨浦区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: His parents were allowed to visit ________ in prison once a month.
questions.topicReason: visit为及物动词，后接人称代词宾格him作宾语。

questions.sourceFile: 2026年上海市杨浦区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: I’ve read one comic strip. I’ll read ________ one before class.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词another，表示“再一个、另一个”comic strip。

questions.sourceFile: 2026年上海市杨浦区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: I tried hard to remember the password, but I could think of ________.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词辨析，根据语境“想不起任何东西”应为 nothing。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海浦东初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Damin hangs a light at the front of ________ raft to work in the darkness.
questions.topicReason: 考查形容词性物主代词 his，修饰名词 raft。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海浦东初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Make sure ________ is left behind in the hotel room before you check out.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词辨析，nothing is left behind 表示“没有东西被落下”。

questions.sourceFile: 2026年上海市虹口区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Last year, I saw the wild lions and elephants in Africa with _______ own eyes.
questions.topicReason: 考查形容词性物主代词；with one's own eyes中应填my修饰名词eyes。

questions.sourceFile: 2026年上海市虹口区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: People can take a walk on the footpaths on ______side of the river after dinner.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词/限定词either的用法；river有两边，either side表示“两边中的任一边”。

questions.prompt: Jason made only _______ mistakes, so he got good results in the final exams.
questions.topicReason: 考查表示数量的不定限定词辨析；mistakes为可数名词复数，only a few表示“只有几个”。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海金山初三一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: —Is this your sister’s smartwatch? —No, it’s ________. She bought it for my birthday.
questions.topicReason: 考查名词性物主代词；空格处独立作表语，表示“我的手表”，用mine。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海闵行初三一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: All of the guests showed up at the party,and the host welcomed ________ warmly.
questions.topicReason: 考查人称代词宾格；welcomed后作宾语，应用them。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海闵行初三一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Sam has a big dream of being a dancer. ________ can stop him from standing on the stage.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词辨析；根据语境“没有什么能阻止他”，应用Nothing。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海青浦初三一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Only Tom was selected for the national team, while ________ remained in the club.
